meta.prompt: Show the twelve invoices you found as a table with number, customer, date, amount and status: #1001 Acme Corp May 02 $1,200 Paid; #1002 Globex May 05 $860 Due; #1003 Initech May 09 $430 Overdue; #1004 Umbrella May 12 $2,250 Paid; #1005 Hooli May 15 $975 Due; #1006 Stark Ltd May 16 $3,100 Overdue; #1007 Wayne Co May 18 $640 Paid; #1008 Wonka May 20 $1,480 Due; #1009 Soylent May 22 $300 Overdue; #1010 Cyberdyne May 24 $5,200 Paid; #1011 Tyrell May 27 $760 Due; #1012 Aperture May 29 $1,890 Paid. I can sort by any column (date first), filter by status (All, Paid, Due, Overdue), type to search the customer, page through five at a time, and tick rows (and tick all on the page). When anything is ticked a bar shows "N selected" with the total of the ticked amounts and a button to send reminders.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Invoices" "12 invoices" icon:"receipt_long" status:"12 total"
  state rows=[{"id":"1001","customer":"Acme Corp","date":"May 02","amount":1200,"status":"Paid"},{"id":"1002","customer":"Globex","date":"May 05","amount":860,"status":"Due"},{"id":"1003","customer":"Initech","date":"May 09","amount":430,"status":"Overdue"},{"id":"1004","customer":"Umbrella","date":"May 12","amount":2250,"status":"Paid"},{"id":"1005","customer":"Hooli","date":"May 15","amount":975,"status":"Due"},{"id":"1006","customer":"Stark Ltd","date":"May 16","amount":3100,"status":"Overdue"},{"id":"1007","customer":"Wayne Co","date":"May 18","amount":640,"status":"Paid"},{"id":"1008","customer":"Wonka","date":"May 20","amount":1480,"status":"Due"},{"id":"1009","customer":"Soylent","date":"May 22","amount":300,"status":"Overdue"},{"id":"1010","customer":"Cyberdyne","date":"May 24","amount":5200,"status":"Paid"},{"id":"1011","customer":"Tyrell","date":"May 27","amount":760,"status":"Due"},{"id":"1012","customer":"Aperture","date":"May 29","amount":1890,"status":"Paid"}]
  state sort="date"
  state desc=false
  state filter="All"
  state query=""
  state page=0
  state picked=[]
  let matched = filter(rows, r => (filter == "All" or r.status == filter) and (query == "" or contains(lower(r.customer), lower(query))))
  let sorted = desc ? sortByDesc(matched, r => r[sort]) : sortBy(matched, r => r[sort])
  let pages = max(1, ceil(length(sorted) / 5))
  let shown = slice(sorted, page * 5, page * 5 + 5)
  let pickedTotal = sum(filter(rows, r => contains(picked, r.id)), r => r.amount)
  Row gap:8
    Segments =filter options:["All","Paid","Due","Overdue"]
  InputField "Search customer" "Type a name" =query
  WideScroll width:390
    TableHeader =sort desc:desc columns:["Number","Customer","Date","Amount","Status"] keys:["id","customer","date","amount","status"] selectable:true checked:=length(picked)==length(shown) -> picked=length(picked)==length(shown)?[]:map(shown,r=>r.id)
    each r in shown
      TableRow cells:=[r.id,r.customer,r.date,money(r.amount,"$",0)] badge:=r.status selectable:true checked:=contains(picked,r.id) -> picked=contains(picked,r.id)?without(picked,r.id):append(picked,r.id)
  Pager =page count:=pages
  if length(picked) > 0
    TotalBar "{length(picked)} selected" "Total {money(pickedTotal,"$",0)}" amount:=money(pickedTotal,"$",0) cta:"Send reminders" icon:"mail" -> emit remind picked; toast "Reminders sent"
